name: 71-forms

name: 42-inline-format
note: The first line's words stand up to 1.4 pt along the line from where wkhtmltopdf puts them (subscript and superscript). The pages look the same.

name: certificate

name: statement

name: javascript

name: invoice-ar
note: A real difference: marqius-wkhtmltopdf draws Arabic letters unjoined and in reverse order within each word, and does not mirror the right-to-left table. Arabic is not supported yet.

name: letter-hi
note: Both pages look alike. From 0.12.7 marqius-wkhtmltopdf's text reads back as clean Hindi; wkhtmltopdf's does not (16 of its letters have no text at all), which is most of the text measure's loss. A few joined letters are drawn in another form. Up to 0.12.6, bold Hindi came out regular (FreeSans, not FreeSans Bold), and neither PDF gave back clean Devanagari text.

name: receipt-th
note: The pages look the same. From 0.12.7 marqius-wkhtmltopdf's text reads back as clean Thai; wkhtmltopdf's comes back with tone and vowel marks split off, which the text measure counts. Up to 0.12.6, the bold heading came out regular (FreeSerif, not FreeSerif Bold), and neither PDF gave back clean Thai text.

name: greek-russian
note: marqius-wkhtmltopdf sets both floated columns 9.6 pt lower; everything else is the same.

name: invoice-zh
note: The pages look the same. wkhtmltopdf's text reads back with some characters as radicals (⻛ for 风), which the text measure counts. Up to 0.12.6, the line with the dates broke into three lines with marqius-wkhtmltopdf, two with wkhtmltopdf.

name: letter-ja
note: The pages look the same. wkhtmltopdf sets the text in Noto Sans Mono CJK HK, marqius-wkhtmltopdf in Noto Sans CJK JP, the face lang="ja" asks for; wkhtmltopdf's text reads back with some characters as radicals.

name: mixed-scripts
note: The pages look the same. wkhtmltopdf sets all the Chinese, Japanese and Korean words in Noto Sans CJK HK, marqius-wkhtmltopdf in Noto Sans CJK JP.

name: receipt-ko
note: The pages look the same. The wide space after the time reads back as a different space character in the two PDFs.

name: script-file
note: A real difference: marqius-wkhtmltopdf runs scripts written in the page, but not one the page loads from a file (<script src>), so the delivery note's number, lines and parcel count, which script-file.js writes, are missing.
